data.gender_notes: Koustav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Koustav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kou' which means 'Lord' and 'Sav' which means 'of the Universe'. This name signifies the one who rules over the entire cosmos. The name Koustav carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Koustav usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine leadership and cosmic awareness.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Koustav total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
